column3: MT 2:3. Close to the Hebrew; “from my distress” is rendered “because of my affliction.”
MT 2:4. Close to the Hebrew; “a river” is rendered “the floods.”
MT 2:6. Close to the Hebrew; “to the neck” (the word can also mean “soul”) is rendered “even to my soul,” and “rushes” “Weeds.”
MT 2:7. Close to the Hebrew; “the extremities of the mountains” is rendered “the moorings of the mountains.”
MT 2:9. NKJV renders “vanities of nothingness” as “worthless idols,” and “their loyalty” as “their own Mercy,” capitalized as a reference to God.
MT 2:10. Close to the Hebrew; “rescue” is rendered “Salvation.”
